title: vehicle-sil GUI WebSocket command event message (Protocol v4)
description: Validates a GUI server WebSocket `event` message carrying a launcher `command` event (Events v4 / Protocol v4). Matches libs/launch/src/format/events.cpp and gui/server WebSocket framing.

run_id.description: GUI server run ID (`<instance>-<n>`) that owns this event.

seq.description: Per-stream monotonic launcher event sequence number.

t_ms.description: Wall-clock milliseconds elapsed since the launcher started (present on real Events v4 events).

run.description: Launcher run identifier on in-window `serve` events.

command.description: Command name (for example `pause`, `resume`, `step`, `run_until`, `speed`, `stop`), or `null` if the line had no valid command name.

source.description: Where the command entered the launcher.

accepted.description: Whether the launcher accepted the command.

message.description: Human-readable explanation (typically populated when `accepted` is `false`, `null` when accepted).

reason.description: Stable lowercase-hyphenated refusal code when `accepted` is `false`; always `null` when `accepted` is `true`.

ms.description: Effective virtual milliseconds stepped (present on accepted `step` commands).

at_ms.description: Effective target virtual timestamp in milliseconds (present on accepted `step`, `run_until`, or `pause` with target).

asked_run.description: Run ID requested on a launcher-level refusal emitted outside an active run window.

id.description: Caller-supplied command correlation integer (`0..2^53`), or `null` if omitted.
